name: Globalization

subjectOf.text: Future financial crises may be inevitable, because globalization, financial innovation, ethical challenges, suboptimal institutional designs, and the bounded rationality of decision makers create conditions that produce crises.
subjectOf.abstract: Future financial crises may be inevitable. Factors such as globalization, financial innovation, ethical challenges, suboptimal institutional designs, and the bounded rationality of decision makers may create conditions that result in future crises.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Dynamic Regulation of the Financial Services Industry (2013). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2273857

subjectOf.text: Financial innovation, the globalization of markets, transnationalism, ethical challenges, and the bounded rationality of humans are likely to create and increase future challenges that require additional and more extensive governance adjustments.
subjectOf.abstract: Financial innovation, the globalization of markets, transnationalism, ethical challenges, and the bounded rationality of humans, among many other factors, are likely to create and perhaps increase future challenges that may require additional and perhaps more extensive governance adjustments.
subjectOf.citation: Kaal, A Comparative Perspective on the Limitations of the Duty of Oversight – A Comment on Lisa Fairfax (2013)
